services.title: Exterior architectural visualization
services.meta: Photorealistic exterior renders for architects and developers: facades, surroundings and photo-integration, by dsgn·dm archviz in Santander, Spain.
services.lead: Images that place the building in its real context — light, vegetation, scale and street — before a single brick is laid.
includes: Photorealistic stills for print and web
Landscape, vegetation and people at the right scale
usefulFor: Design reviews between architect and developer
faqs: Can you work from a drone photo or site photograph?
Yes. A photograph of the real plot lets me match light and perspective so the building sits naturally in its surroundings.
How many images does a project usually need?
Often two to four exterior views: a main one at eye level, an aerial or approach view and one alternative or detail. We settle this in the brief.

services.title: Interior visualization
services.meta: Interior renders that validate materials, furniture and light before construction. Architectural visualization by dsgn·dm archviz, Santander.
services.lead: Furnished, lit and styled spaces that let your client understand — and approve — an interior before anything is bought or built.
includes: View planning based on your floor plans
usefulFor: Validating a design with the client
faqs: Do you choose the furniture?
I can propose it from catalogues or model the pieces your designer specifies. Either way, we agree the selection before rendering.
Can I see two material options?
Yes. Once the scene is built, alternatives of the same view are quick to produce, and we define them in the proposal.

services.title: Architectural animation
services.meta: Full HD architectural walkthroughs and flythroughs with calm, deliberate camera work. dsgn·dm archviz, Santander, Spain.
services.lead: Walkthroughs and flythroughs that show a building in motion, with calm camera work that follows the way people will actually move through it.
includes: Titles and your music, if you provide them
MP4 plus a lighter web version
faqs: How long can the video be?
Most are between 30 and 90 seconds. Length and number of shots drive both time and price, so we define the shot list in the brief.
Can you animate people and cars?
Yes, where they add life to the scene. They are kept subtle so the architecture remains the protagonist.

services.title: Sales material for real estate
services.meta: Colour floor plans, infographics and visual assets for real estate promotions. dsgn·dm archviz, Santander, Spain.
services.lead: Colour floor plans, infographics and assets that turn a development into something easy to understand, present and sell.
includes: Colour floor plans and unit plans
Infographics with areas, orientation and amenities
Artwork for site hoardings and brochures
Assets for property portals and promotion websites
One consistent look across every piece
faqs: Can you work from the architect's CAD plans?
Yes. DWG or PDF plans are the usual starting point, and I redraw them into a clean, readable layout.
Do you design the brochure itself?
I produce the plans and visual assets and can lay out simple pieces. For larger brand pieces I deliver everything ready for your designer to place.

services.title: 3D architectural visualization in Santander & Cantabria
services.meta: 3D architectural visualization studio in Santander, Cantabria: renders, animation and sales material for architects, developers and interior designers.
services.lead: A local studio for architects, developers and interior designers in Cantabria, with a workflow that works just as well anywhere else in Spain.
includes: Meetings in Santander when they help the brief
A fully remote workflow for everything else
usefulFor: Architecture studios in Santander, Torrelavega and across Cantabria
Projects in Asturias, the Basque Country and the rest of Spain
faqs: Do you work with clients outside Cantabria?
Yes. Brief, approvals and delivery all work remotely, so location is not a limit.
Can we meet in person?
Of course, in Santander and nearby when it helps with the brief. Otherwise calls and shared folders keep things moving.
